assessments.kind: conditional current source observation; continuation of existing queue question
assessments.contract: The placement graph stores point and rotation in separate maps. `register` computes global `shield.grip` and `grip.base/top/center` positions from a component pose but records rotation under the component resolved ID. `attached` finds the target point by full frame text, splits that text at the final dot and looks up rotation by its textual owner, defaulting to [0,0,0] if absent. If a reachable global alias uses a prefix different from its actual rotated component ID, and no component with the alias prefix supplies a matching rotation, a nonzero overlap is directed using zero rotation instead of the source component rotation. A different component with that prefix may also supply an unrelated rotation.
assessments.condition: The frame constants, map writes and fallback are current source facts. Validation permits general IDs and overlap 0..0.15 at the inspected top-level but invokes further shape-specific validators. A complete admitted nonzero-overlap recipe, intended alias semantics, producer ordering, downstream geometry and actual output have not been established. No fixture, model generation or product execution occurred.
assessments.future_direction: Trace allowed aliases, complete recipe construction and concrete consumers; if the condition is confirmed, make a single owner carry point and orientation/identity, retaining legitimate root and shaft semantics without an assumed compatibility fallback.
relationships: 059 queue127 ADLER-L11-ATTACHMENT-FRAME-OWNER already describes the owner/pose question; this independent 95e source observation is not a new duplicate issue or automatic alias decision.

assessments.kind: bounded nonfinding and separately attributed historical relationship
assessments.contract: resolve receives an immutable Recipe, scans grip width, clones it, normalizes facing on the clone, initializes a private graph and inserts each component. insert sets the clone component ID to resolved_id before calling attached, whose ID unwrap thus has a shown immediate private predecessor. The normalized clone is returned in ResolvedRecipe; it is not an in-place update to the caller. Metres::new is called on each coordinate of the final offset before the component is returned.
assessments.condition: This establishes the shown call order and local scratch ownership, not that every constructor, unchecked arithmetic, shape constraint or external holder/mesh consumer is safe. Other paths to `attached` and any parent alias collision must be traced before a universal claim.
assessments.future_direction: Trace the retained resolved identity through the actual holder, mesh and generated-model consumers, preserving the difference between authored optional identity and resolved identity.
relationships: Camera witness CAMERA-ADM03-028 and prior ROOT-ADM-F002 concern original caller versus normalized identity and downstream holder/mesh assumptions. Their source/counterexample are historical reviewer evidence; this packet does not independently re-establish downstream current reachability.
